notes: Coordinates: front=-Y, up=+Z. Per user correction, IMU is on the opposite (+X) edge; holes face outward (+X), header inward (-X).
IMU supplied drawing dimensions the board and hole diameter, but not hole centers. 15.24 mm pitch and 2.54 mm edge offset are reference estimates; plate uses short slots.
LD06 geometry, including its installed housing screws and connector, is preserved at scale 1. Source +Y is rotated to assembly +Z. Connector points -X.

Two 18 mm M2 female spacers enter the LD06 4.8 mm counterbores by 11.8 mm, leaving 6.2 mm beneath its base. Spacer thread and screw lengths are assembly references requiring physical fit confirmation.
Third layer reuses the four existing M3 support axes. Prior top screw references are replaced by M3 male-female extension posts, 45 mm body with 8 mm lower stud (5 mm plate plus 3 mm engagement).
Screen is flat/face-up in portrait orientation at the requested image-left red area; perfboard is rotated 90 degrees in the XY plane and moved image-right (+X).
AT043TN24 PDF dimensions only the bare LCD/touch unit. Complete PCB footprint is reference 116x67.2 (product image labels 116x67, with 0.2 allowance for the documented bare-panel dimension).

Screen module hole pitch 112x56, PCB thickness 1.6, rear connector envelope 43.18x5.08x9 and 12mm spacers are references, not manufacturer verified module dimensions. Plate uses 4x8mm adjustable slots; verify real hardware before manufacture.
